sn19.12:1.1: idhāhaṃ āvuso gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ purisaṃ gūthakūpe nimuggaṃ ubhohi hatthehi gūthaṃ khādantaṃ.
sn19.12:1.2: eso bhikkhave satto imasmiññeva rājagahe brāhmaṇo ahosi.
sn19.12:1.3: so kassapassa sammāsambuddhassa pāvacane bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhattena nimantetvā doṇiyā gūthassa pūrāpetvā kālaṃ ārocāpetvā etadavoca
sn19.12:1.4: aho bhonto yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjantu ceva harantu cāti.
